title: Connect an Agent's snippets name the MCP server "objectstack" while the boot banner prints `claude mcp add … <app name>` — use one server name, the app's or the deployment's, in both (hotcrm#2194 T2-U22)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 连接智能体页的配置片段把 MCP 服务器叫 objectstack，启动横幅却打印 `claude mcp add … hotcrm`，一个端点两个名字。
- **要做：** 两处使用同一个名字（应用名或部署名）。
- **完成标准：** 片段与横幅一致。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T2-U22**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Connect an Agent and the dev server's boot banner, the system administrator.
- **Now:** the snippets name the server "objectstack"; the boot banner says `claude mcp add … hotcrm`.
- **Cost:** two names for one endpoint.
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/REPORT.md), U-22; [`39-integrations-connect-agent-full.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/39-integrations-connect-agent-full.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

Read on objectstack `origin/main` `7b047b44`:
- `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` ~:110: `claude mcp add --transport http objectstack ${url}`, plus the `mcp:connect-agent` component's snippets (console).
- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` ~:192: the banner prints `${opts.name}`.

## Done when

- The Connect an Agent snippets, the served SKILL.md and the boot banner name the server the same way.
- A pin that the two producers read one source for the name.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectstack issue (108) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (544, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `mcp`, `server name`, `claude mcp add`. 2 open hits: #25308 (a REST action door) and #20791 (MCP distribution). Not on point. **New.**
